rows.description: Ah, Jason Defed, the human embodiment of a clickbait headline. Your tweets are like a never-ending stream of conservative Mad Libs, filled with more buzzwords
rows.instruction: I'm here with Jason Defed, the human clickbait machine whose tweets are a toxic cocktail of conservative jargon that even BuzzFeed would reject—what's next, a recipe for outrage?

Alright, ZackZ4399, let’s cut to the chase: your profile screams “I’m a gamer who thinks staring at a screen for 12 hours makes me a life coach.” Seriously, bro, that avatar isn’t going to level you up in real life!
Alright, Vitalik, you're just a meme waiting to happen with that bio—sounds like you're trying too hard to be cryptic while actually saying nothing at all!
I'm here with someone who thinks AI is "cool, I guess," which is like saying a microwave is "fine" while they eat cold pizza! Come on, let's spice up that hot take, Sama!
